evidence_quotes.section1_quid_pro_quo: Rep never framed the call duration, the quote promise, or asked for permission to proceed. Jumped straight into 'are we moving it out from an apartment or?' with no opening frame.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Reps asked 'Alright. Before I discuss the pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any concerns about the moving process.' — This came after extensive logistics probing (property type, rooms, parking, box counts, appliances, destination details), not before. Customer replied 'No, none at all I would love to get some help,' — no concerns raised.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer indicated no concerns were present.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — customer raised no concerns, so no reflection was needed.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floor/stories (1 flight upstairs at origin, 1 flight at destination), bedrooms (2 at origin, 1 at destination), parking (attached garage both locations), additional rooms/special items (king mattress, 3 couches, dresser, refrigerator, 50-inch TV), square footage (1000 sf origin, 800 sf destination), walking distance (minimal, garage attached).
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Never asked. Rep asked about box count expectations but not whether customer wants packing service.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: 'And normally for a two bedroom apartment we see 25 to 35 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?' — Asked and customer responded '25 or less.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gave range and personalization: 'Since we're moving from a apartment to another apartment on the second floor with their access, I estimate the move to finish in three and a half to four and a half hours estimated cost is $714 to $918.' Also explained personalization driver: 'if ever that the move will take less than this most especially you are really ready to go then that would really help keep the time down.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep disclosed hourly rate ($102/mover, $204 for two movers), what's included (gas, truck, taxes, insurance, wraps, pads, tools), what's not included (no hidden fees, no credit card fees, no serial fees, no disassemble/reassemble fee), and minimum/increments: 'And for every move, we do have a minimum of two and a half hour after that minim move. The time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.' Fully transparent.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or any variant. Customer said 'Okay, that sounds good. I'm pretty confident we can do it in about three but we'll see what happens,' but rep did not solicit this — customer volunteered it.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Never mentioned. No reference to any on-time guarantee or discount terms for lateness.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Never mentioned. No reference to No Worries coverage, $2,000 protection, or no-deductible framing.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirm understanding of the Two Promises section, because the promises were never delivered.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asked 'Do you have any questions before I let you go?' — This is a throwaway closing question, not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Never asked 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep said 'Would you like to be on the schedule?' — Direct ask without a soft out. Customer replied 'Yes.'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No discussion of rate lock or price guarantee.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep confirmed: arrival window (11 AM to 1 PM Wednesday September 30th), unit numbers (2521 origin, 2808 destination), and will send confirmation email with date, time, addresses, contact info. Missing: phone number confirmation (already collected earlier but not re-confirmed as part of booking recap), crew size (2 movers mentioned but not confirmed as part of final booking), and notes about customer's concerns/priorities (none were raised, so this doesn't apply). Partial.

top_strength: Jeline gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, floor/stories, room counts, parking accessibility, special items, square footage, walking distance) and efficiently probed for all relevant moving factors, resulting in a confident, personalized estimate that the customer accepted immediately.
coaching_note: Section 1 must always open with the quid pro quo framing (availability + 10–15 minutes + dependable quote + wait for yes) before any probing; you skipped this entirely and jumped to logistics questions, and you also never delivered the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) before booking, leaving $20 pts on the board.
